card.text: A Cepheid in the galaxy NGC 4536, 15 million parsecs away, that swells and shrinks every 30.2 days.

sources.label: Hoffmann et al. (2016)

introduction.text: The Hubble Space Telescope found it and timed its pulsation at 30.2 days. Its galaxy's distance, 15.2 million parsecs, was measured from Cepheids like it.
